title: Design System: Quantum Use Case Zoo

neutral-stamp.canonical: #6b7280 (fixed, true neutral, not derived from the warm hue family)

display.purpose: Home page H1 only, Fraunces serif, kept deliberately small (1.9rem) so it doesn't compete with the tile grid.

body.purpose: All running text, max ~42ch on the thesis paragraph.

label.purpose: Filter pills, verdict badges, metadata field labels — uppercase, small, JetBrains Mono or Work Sans.

shadows.name: tile-hover-lift
shadows.purpose: The only shadow in the system. Appears on use-case tile hover, paired with translateY(-6px). Reserved for the page's hero component.

motion.name: tile-hover
motion.purpose: Tile lift on hover, with a slight springy overshoot — the system's one deliberate animated moment.

motion.name: badge-stamp-tilt
motion.purpose: Verdict badge tilts (rotate(-2deg) scale(1.06)) on tile hover, like a rubber stamp being pressed — a literal nod to the 'verdict stamp' metaphor.

motion.name: pill-press
motion.purpose: Tiny tactile feedback on filter pill click, not a hover effect.

components.css: .ds-tile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 1.75rem; min-height: 210px; background: #b53e20; border-radius: 1rem; text-decoration: none; color: #fff; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), box-shadow 0.3s ease; } .ds-tile:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: 0 16px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.18); } .ds-tile-badge { align-self: flex-start; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; padding: 0.25rem 0.6rem; border-radius: 0.35rem; margin-bottom: 1.25rem; background: #7c9048; color: #221812; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1); } .ds-tile:hover .ds-tile-badge { transform: rotate(-2deg) scale(1.06); } .ds-tile-title { margin: 0 0 0.5rem 0; font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 600; color: #fff; font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif; } .ds-tile-meta { margin: 0.15rem 0; font-size: 0.85rem; color: #fff; }

narrative.overview:
A working scientist's notebook, not a glossy report. The surface is warm parchment, the ink is real ink, and the verdicts read like a researcher's own marginalia — stamped, dated, sourced. The personality lives in restraint and precision, not in gradients or motion: a calm, plain-spoken authority that's earned, with just enough warmth and idiosyncrasy that it reads as written by a sharp human scientist rather than generated by a template.

The system explicitly rejects glossy quantum-startup marketing (gradient/particle backgrounds, qubit-sphere animations, breathless "quantum advantage" claims) and generic SaaS landing pages (oversized heroes, stock illustration, gradient blobs, marketing-fluff copy) in equal measure. It also rejects the opposite failure mode — a flat, personality-free academic template — by keeping one bold, deliberate gesture: the verdict tiles, rendered as solid warm-ink color blocks that lift slightly on hover, the single moment of "delight" the system allows itself.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, paper-toned neutrals carry the page; one saturated rust ink does the brand work
Flat by default; depth is earned only through interaction (hover), never decorative
Verdicts are color-coded like rubber stamps — fixed colors, not theme-reactive
Generous whitespace; the tile grid is the hero, everything else is deliberately compact

rules.name: The Tinted Surface Rule
rules.body: The background is warm parchment, not pure white/black, because the mood is explicitly environmental — a notebook page, not a SaaS app shell.

rules.name: The Fixed Stamp Rule
rules.body: Verdict badge colors never change with light/dark mode. A verdict is a fact about the world, not a UI preference.

rules.name: The Quiet Headline Rule
rules.body: Display type never exceeds ~2rem on the home page. The headline's job is to get out of the way fast so the tile grid reads as the main feature.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Touched Rule
rules.body: Every surface is flat at rest. Depth appears only as a direct response to hover on the tile component — never as ambient decoration elsewhere.

dos: Do keep the home page header compact (display type ≤ 2rem) — the tile grid is the main feature, not the headline.
Do use solid, opaque white text on use-case tiles. Translucent white drops below WCAG AA against the Cinnabar Ink fill.
Do keep verdict badge colors fixed across light/dark mode.
Do match badge text color to the specific fill: dark ink on Sage/Amber, white on Neutral Stamp.
Do leave every surface flat at rest; reserve shadow/lift for the tile hover state only.
donts: Don't add gradient or particle backgrounds, qubit-sphere animations, or breathless "quantum advantage" copy.
Don't add oversized hero sections, stock illustration, gradient blobs, or marketing-fluff copy.
Don't crowd the landing page — cut or clearly divide any section that competes with the tile grid for attention.
Don't introduce a second accent hue for decoration — Cinnabar Ink carries the brand alone.
Don't apply resting shadows to cards, pills, or boxes.
